children: Darden reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 EPS guidance of $11.10 to $11.35 following first-quarter results. The company is navigating a one-week offset in year-over-year comparisons after transitioning from a 53-week to a 52-week fiscal year. To address this, Darden is reporting same-restaurant sales on both fiscal and comparable calendar bases. First-quarter blended same-restaurant sales rose 3.1% on a fiscal basis and 3.2% on a comparable basis.
